mapper.select: SELECT p.category, STRING_AGG(p.name, ', ') AS names, ARRAY_AGG(p.product_id) AS ids FROM product p WHERE p.name ILIKE #{pattern} AND p.updated_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category

SELECT d.day, COUNT(o.order_id) AS cnt FROM GENERATE_SERIES(#{from}::date, #{to}::date, INTERVAL '1 day') AS d(day) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_on = d.day ) o ON TRUE GROUP BY d.day
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (product_id, qty) VALUES (#{id}, #{qty}) ON CONFLICT (product_id) DO UPDATE SET qty = EXCLUDED.qty
mapper.select: SELECT TOP (#{limit}) p.product_id, LEN(p.name) AS name_len, IIF(p.price > 100, 'high', 'low') AS band, CHARINDEX('-', p.code) AS dash_at FROM product p WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE p.updated_at >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, ordered_on) VALUES (NEWID(), GETDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT category, [1] AS q1, [2] AS q2, [3] AS q3, [4] AS q4 FROM (SELECT category, quarter, amount FROM sales) s PIVOT (SUM(amount) FOR quarter IN ([1], [2], [3], [4])) pv
SELECT VARCHAR_FORMAT(o.ordered_on, 'YYYY-MM') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o GROUP BY VARCHAR_FORMAT(o.ordered_on, 'YYYY-MM') WITH UR
